blocks.text: Action potentials ki taqat (amplitude) axon ki lambai mein yaksan rehti hai: aakhri pehle jitna hi taqatwar hota hai. Magar raftar badalti hai: axon chaura ho ya myelinated ho to zyada hoti hai.

Myelinated axons mein action potentials sirf nodes of Ranvier par bante aur myelin wale hisson ko chhor kar node se node chhalang lagate hain. Yeh saltatory conduction tez tareen non-myelinated axons se 50 guna tak tez hai. Insanon mein non-myelinated neurons 1 se 3 metre fi second aur myelinated neurons 120 metre fi second tak raftar se impulse le jate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: baghair myelin ka axon, bahar + aur andar - charges, siwaye aik surkh active hisse ke jahan charges ulte hain; teer active hisse ko aage barhta dikhata hai jabke peeche wala hissa repolarize hota hai. Neeche: myelin wala axon, neele myelin ke tukre aur surkh mure teer jo aik node of Ranvier se agle tak chhalang lagate hain. Note: baghair myelin 1 se 3 m/s aur myelin ke saath 120 m/s tak.
blocks.caption: Myelinated axon mein saltatory conduction (Figure 15.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Action potential khud safar nahi karta: har active hissa agle ko depolarize karta hai jo apna action potential banata hai, jabke peeche wala hissa repolarize hota hai. Axon par is ki taqat yaksan rehti hai. Myelin wale axon mein action potentials sirf nodes of Ranvier par bante aur node se node chhalang lagate hain (saltatory conduction), tez tareen baghair myelin axons se 50 guna tak tez.

blocks.prompt: Neuron a mein impulses neuron b se tez chalte hain. Do mumkina wajahein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Neuron a myelinated hai (saltatory conduction), ya us ka axon b se chaura hai.

items: Amplitude yaksan; myelin ya chaure axon se raftar zyada. Saltatory: node se node, 50 guna tak tez; 1 se 3 m/s ke muqable mein 120 m/s tak.
